title: Customizing an integration with Microsoft Dataverse

facts.text: Microsoft Dataverse must include the Worker table from the Talent Core HR solution.
Business Central sandbox environment with CRONUS demo data and working Dataverse integration enabled.
Visual Studio Code with AL Language extension installed for developing extensions.
Create an integration table in Business Central using the AL Table Proxy Generator tool to map a Dataverse table to a Business Central record type.
Create a page using the integration table as data source to display Dataverse data in Business Central.
Subscribe to OnGetCDSTableNo event in CRM Setup Defaults codeunit to enable coupling between Business Central and Dataverse records.
Create integration table mappings linking Business Central tables to integration tables, then add integration field mappings for specific fields.
Custom uncoupling can be enabled by specifying an uncoupling codeunit in integration table mapping to run custom logic before or after removing couplings.
